application.name: Attn Invest
application.description: Jev for Investment Evaluation: versioned theses, traceable evidence, bounded Jev judgments and auditable human decisions.

capabilities.name: appport.manifest
capabilities.description: Returns the application manifest for this deployment.

definitions.description: Returns the application manifest for this deployment.

capabilities.name: appport.ping
capabilities.description: Liveness probe. Returns the server time.

definitions.description: Liveness probe. Returns the server time.

capabilities.name: audit.list
capabilities.description: Append-only audit history for the caller's workspace, newest first.

definitions.description: Append-only audit history for the caller's workspace, newest first.

capabilities.name: decision.record
capabilities.description: Records an investment decision. Invest requires every review gate resolved and no failed or unresolved hard gate.

definitions.description: Records an investment decision. Invest requires every review gate resolved and no failed or unresolved hard gate.

capabilities.name: document.get
capabilities.description: Ingestion status, issues, hashes and parser identity for one document.

definitions.description: Ingestion status, issues, hashes and parser identity for one document.

capabilities.name: document.link
capabilities.description: A short-lived signed link to the original file (five minutes).

definitions.description: A short-lived signed link to the original file (five minutes).

capabilities.name: document.page
capabilities.description: The extracted lines and coordinates of one page, for the source viewer.

definitions.description: The extracted lines and coordinates of one page, for the source viewer.

capabilities.name: document.purge
capabilities.description: Retention control: deletes the original file and extracted page text; evidence claims and hashes remain for audit.

definitions.description: Retention control: deletes the original file and extracted page text; evidence claims and hashes remain for audit.

capabilities.name: document.upload
capabilities.description: Uploads a document (base64). Type, extension and PDF signature are checked before parsing; rejected and failed files are recorded with their reasons and no evidence.

definitions.description: Uploads a document (base64). Type, extension and PDF signature are checked before parsing; rejected and failed files are recorded with their reasons and no evidence.

capabilities.name: evaluation.get
capabilities.description: Evaluation report: manifest, findings with reviewer actions applied, open diligence requests, decision history and decision blockers.

definitions.description: Evaluation report: manifest, findings with reviewer actions applied, open diligence requests, decision history and decision blockers.

capabilities.name: evaluation.list
capabilities.description: Evaluations with status, summary and current decision.

definitions.description: Evaluations with status, summary and current decision.

capabilities.name: evaluation.rerun
capabilities.description: Creates a new evaluation linked to its predecessor. The predecessor is never modified.

definitions.description: Creates a new evaluation linked to its predecessor. The predecessor is never modified.

capabilities.name: evaluation.start
capabilities.description: Evaluates a startup against an explicitly selected thesis version. Runs asynchronously; poll evaluation.get.

definitions.description: Evaluates a startup against an explicitly selected thesis version. Runs asynchronously; poll evaluation.get.

capabilities.name: evaluation.verify
capabilities.description: Independently recomputes the manifest digest, projections, question digests and every policy outcome of a stored evaluation.

definitions.description: Independently recomputes the manifest digest, projections, question digests and every policy outcome of a stored evaluation.

capabilities.name: evidence.attach
capabilities.description: Attaches evidence a reviewer verified directly, with how it was verified.

definitions.description: Attaches evidence a reviewer verified directly, with how it was verified.

capabilities.name: evidence.get
capabilities.description: One claim's provenance: source document, hash, page and coordinates, and cross-source verification.

definitions.description: One claim's provenance: source document, hash, page and coordinates, and cross-source verification.

capabilities.name: evidence.list
capabilities.description: Claims for a startup with provenance, derived verification and contradictions.

definitions.description: Claims for a startup with provenance, derived verification and contradictions.

capabilities.name: review.record
capabilities.description: Accept a finding, override its outcome (outcome and reason required), or comment. Findings are never edited.

definitions.description: Accept a finding, override its outcome (outcome and reason required), or comment. Findings are never edited.

capabilities.name: review.request
capabilities.description: Opens a diligence request (follow-up), optionally tied to a finding and assigned to someone.

definitions.description: Opens a diligence request (follow-up), optionally tied to a finding and assigned to someone.

capabilities.name: review.resolve
capabilities.description: Resolves a diligence request. A request can be resolved exactly once.

definitions.description: Resolves a diligence request. A request can be resolved exactly once.

capabilities.name: session.whoami
capabilities.description: The authenticated principal, its workspace and permissions, and the configured Jev identity (never credentials).

definitions.description: The authenticated principal, its workspace and permissions, and the configured Jev identity (never credentials).

capabilities.name: startup.create
capabilities.description: Creates a startup profile. Founder claims are recorded as founder-reported evidence.

definitions.description: Creates a startup profile. Founder claims are recorded as founder-reported evidence.

capabilities.name: startup.get
capabilities.description: Startup and evidence workspace: profile, documents, evidence with provenance, contradictions, evaluations, decisions, and gaps against an optional thesis version.

definitions.description: Startup and evidence workspace: profile, documents, evidence with provenance, contradictions, evaluations, decisions, and gaps against an optional thesis version.

capabilities.name: startup.list
capabilities.description: Startups in the caller's workspace.

definitions.description: Startups in the caller's workspace.

capabilities.name: startup.update
capabilities.description: Updates a startup profile, fenced on expectedVersion.

definitions.description: Updates a startup profile, fenced on expectedVersion.

capabilities.name: thesis.approve
capabilities.description: Freezes the draft as the next immutable version. Previous versions are never modified.

definitions.description: Freezes the draft as the next immutable version. Previous versions are never modified.

capabilities.name: thesis.create
capabilities.description: Creates a thesis with a draft. Nothing is evaluable until a version is approved.

definitions.description: Creates a thesis with a draft. Nothing is evaluable until a version is approved.

capabilities.name: thesis.draft.discard
capabilities.description: Discards the draft of a thesis that already has an approved version.

definitions.description: Discards the draft of a thesis that already has an approved version.

capabilities.name: thesis.draft.update
capabilities.description: Replaces the draft. Fenced on expectedVersion; a stale editor gets CONFLICT instead of overwriting.

definitions.description: Replaces the draft. Fenced on expectedVersion; a stale editor gets CONFLICT instead of overwriting.

capabilities.name: thesis.get
capabilities.description: A thesis with its draft and every approved version.

definitions.description: A thesis with its draft and every approved version.

capabilities.name: thesis.list
capabilities.description: Theses in the caller's workspace.

definitions.description: Theses in the caller's workspace.

capabilities.name: thesis.validate
capabilities.description: Validates criteria and settings without storing anything.

definitions.description: Validates criteria and settings without storing anything.

capabilities.name: thesis.version.compare
capabilities.description: Criterion-level differences between two versions, or between a version and the current draft.

definitions.description: Criterion-level differences between two versions, or between a version and the current draft.

capabilities.name: thesis.version.get
capabilities.description: One immutable thesis version.

definitions.description: One immutable thesis version.

capabilities.name: workspace.overview
capabilities.description: Active evaluations, outstanding reviews, recently completed assessments and startups awaiting evidence.

definitions.description: Active evaluations, outstanding reviews, recently completed assessments and startups awaiting evidence.
